findings: Initial Profile read failure can render a blank editable form with the error below the sections.
A failed load for a newly signed-in user can retain and display the previous user draft while Profile remains mounted.
severity: S2: unsafe failure UI and possible prior-user draft exposure
acceptance: No runtime cross-identity behavior claimed. D94 stays in-fix pending native save/reopen/restoration acceptance. Earlier T02 blank-input observation invalidated for acceptance.
